author: Chris Schommer
title: Jake McCarthy triples, swipes base in win over Twins
desc: Jake McCarthy went 2-for-5 in a win over the Twins with a triple, one stolen base, and two runs scored.
impact: McCarthy continues a torrid stretch at the plate, registering hits in 17 of his last 19 contests. The outfielder continues to reward fantasy managers as one of the few impactful options in the Rockies lineup, hitting .305 with six home runs, 34 RBI, 31 runs scored, and 13 stolen bases across 68 games.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Ezequiel Tovar steals base in win over Twins
desc: Ezequiel Tovar went 1-for-1 in an 8-5 win over the Twins with a walk, one run scored, and one stolen base.
impact: Tovar has fought consistency issues at the plate, picking up hits in four of his last 10 contests. The shortstop remains one of many underperforming options in the Rockies lineup to this point, slashing .211 with six home runs, five steals, 25 RBI, and 26 runs scored across 77 games.

author: Bruno Mulé
title: Christian Scott strikes out six in return
desc: Christian Scott did not factor into the decision Saturday against the Phillies, allowing two runs on three hits and two walks over 4.1 innings. He struck out six and generated 17 swinging strikes on 82 pitches in his first appearance since June 11, with a two-run homer by Bryce Harper accounting for all the damage.
impact: Scott has worked beyond the fifth inning just twice in 10 outings this season. He owns a 3.20 ERA, 1.33 WHIP, and 53:21 K across 45 innings and is scheduled to face Atlanta on the road next weekend.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Hunter Goodman goes deep three times in win over Twins
desc: Hunter Goodman went 3-for-5 in a win over the Twins with three home runs, three runs scored, and five RBI.
impact: Goodman has heated back up at the plate, recording hits in four of his last five contests. The 26-year-old continues to offer manager Warren Schaeffer one of the more explosive bats in the Rockies lineup, carrying an .855 OPS with 25 home runs, 47 RBI, 52 runs scored, and five stolen bases through 77 games.

author: Bruno Mulé
title: Jake Burger collects three hits in win
desc: Jake Burger went 3-for-5 with a run scored, two RBI, and a stolen base in Saturday's 7-4 win over the Blue Jays. All three of his hits were singles, and the multi-hit effort was his third in his last six games.
impact: Burger is batting .377 with three doubles, four home runs, eight runs, and 13 RBI over his last 18 contests. Saturday's steal was his second of the season, establishing a new career high.

author: Bruno Mulé
title: Tyler Alexander records third save
desc: Tyler Alexander worked a perfect ninth inning Saturday to record his third save of the season in Texas' 7-4 win over Toronto. He did not record a strikeout while filling in after Jacob Latz and Jakob Junis had each pitched on the previous two days.
impact: Alexander has allowed a run in just one of eight appearances this month, posting a 1.08 ERA, 1.04 WHIP, and 6:2 K over 8.2 innings. His high-leverage work has remained limited, with Saturday's save joining one hold and no wins in June.

author: Bruno Mulé
title: Cal Quantrill delivers four scoreless innings
desc: Cal Quantrill did not factor into the decision Saturday against the Blue Jays after allowing two hits and one walk over four scoreless innings. He struck out five while throwing 36 of his 55 pitches for strikes in Texas' 7-4 win.
impact: Quantrill is making a case to remain in the rotation while Jack Leiter is sidelined with an ankle injury. He owns a 3.31 ERA, 1.22 WHIP, and 25:11 K across 35.1 innings and is scheduled to face the Tigers at home next week.

author: Bruno Mulé
title: Anthony Seigler hits first career homer
desc: Anthony Seigler went 1-for-2 with a walk and a solo home run in Saturday's 4-1 win over the Yankees. Starting at second base and batting seventh, he took a 97.3 mph fastball from Gerrit Cole the other way over the Green Monster in the second inning.
impact: The homer was the first of Seigler's career in his 44th major-league game. He is batting .333 with two doubles, two RBI, and five runs over eight consecutive starts for Boston.

author: Bruno Mulé
title: Aroldis Chapman secures 16th save
desc: Aroldis Chapman worked around one walk and struck out one batter in a scoreless ninth inning Saturday to close out Boston's 4-1 win over the Yankees. It was his 16th save of the season and second of the series.
impact: Chapman has blown just one save this season and owns a 1.90 ERA, 1.23 WHIP, and 30:11 K across 23.2 innings.

author: Bruno Mulé
title: Jake Bennett earns second win with quality start
desc: Jake Bennett earned the win Saturday against the Yankees after allowing one run on three hits and two walks over 6.1 innings. He struck out three while throwing 59 of his 87 pitches for strikes in Boston's 4-1 victory.
impact: Bennett has recorded quality starts in consecutive outings and owns a 3.27 ERA, 1.06 WHIP, and 25:7 K through his first six major-league appearances. He is scheduled to face the Angels on the road next weekend.

author: Matthew Adam
title: Gabriel Arias chips in a swipe as Cleveland squeaks by Seattle
desc: Gabriel Arias went 1-for-3 in a 4-3 win over the Mariners on Saturday with one stolen base and one strikeout.
impact: After Saturday's win, Arias is hitting .200 with two home runs, five RBI, two runs scored, and one stolen base across 18 games. He has seen more playing time of late with Jose Ramirez sidelined, but Arias isn't making the most of those opportunities, hitting just .143 in his past seven games.

author: Matthew Adam
title: Slade Cecconi blanks Mariners over six in 4-3 win
desc: Slade Cecconi allowed zero earned runs on three hits and two walks while striking out four over six innings in Saturday's win over the Mariners.
impact: Cecconi picked up a much-needed win Saturday against Seattle as his performance on the mound has improved significantly after a rough start to the year. Cecconi now has a 2.84 ERA across his past seven starts. After the outing, he now owns a 4.18 ERA and 1.36 WHIP with a 4-6 record across 17 starts. Cecconi is slated to be back on the mound against the White Sox on Thursday.

author: Matthew Adam
title: Cade Smith locks down save as Guardians edge Mariners
desc: Cade Smith struck out one batter while allowing one hit over a scoreless frame to earn the save in Saturday's 4-3 win over the Mariners.
impact: Smith needed 14 pitches to convert the save in the contest. After Saturday's win, Smith now has a 3.13 ERA and 1.18 WHIP with 25 saves and 56 strikeouts across 35 appearances.

author: Matthew Adam
title: Mike Paredes tagged for three runs in loss vs. Colorado
desc: Mike Paredes allowed three earned runs on eight hits and no walks while striking out two over 5.1 innings in Saturday's 8-5 loss to the Rockies.
impact: Paredes didn't do himself any favors by letting the Rockies put eight balls in play for hits. After the loss, Paredes now has a 4.26 ERA and 1.26 WHIP with a 0-1 record across six appearances. His next start will be against the Yankees on Thursday.

author: Matthew Adam
title: Trevor Larnach drives in three, but Twins fall short vs. Colorado
desc: Trevor Larnach went 3-for-5 in an 8-5 loss to the Rockies on Saturday with a double, one run scored, and three RBI.
impact: Larnach kept Minnesota's lineup afloat even as the bullpen couldn't. After Saturday's loss to Colorado, Larnach is batting .288 with five home runs, 27 RBI, 37 runs scored, and two stolen bases across 68 games. He has been hot of late, hitting .400 with six RBI over his past seven contests.
